Please see the [DUAL ROUND!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BurnabyHandWarmers2027#81477-dual-round) tab for more information.* To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). **Time Zone Reminder for U.S. Competitors: Effective November 2026, British Columbia will remain on daylight saving time year-round. As such, Vancouver will be one hour ahead of Washington state on the date of this competition. Please account for this time difference when planning your travel!** Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.

items.information: L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChanteloupBigsOpen2027#83076-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChanteloupBigsOpen2027#83076-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.
